Both P marks sit on the rising dash that leaves the trough.

Both Q marks catch dot edges, including the dot that touches the vertical grid stroke.
The three P centers catch the edges or interiors of dots, including the dot crossing the grid stroke.

P is on the solid horizontal stroke just before it meets the grid.

The dots turn from a near-vertical path to a shallow rightward path around Q.

P sits well inside the bottom frame, beyond the visible dotted ink.

Q sits inside the terminal dot above the thin grid stroke it touches.

Both marks sit on the dashed branch leaving the force crest.

The sloping dash is continuous through the vertical grid stroke at P.

Q sits at the tip of the descending dash and on the narrow turn at the crest.
Both P marks are on the long near-vertical dash, which continues across the horizontal grid.
Both P marks sit on the gently sloping part of the same dash.
Q sits on the curved left edge of the dash at the turn.

The solid stroke below the scan break runs nearly straight through Q.
P and the nearest Q sample sit on the solid hook tip. The other Q samples sit on the hook's strokes.
Q and the nearby P sample sit on the lower return stroke. The other P samples also sit on hook ink.
